mapper.select: SELECT C.CARD_ID AS "cardId" , C.CARD_NUMBER AS "cardNumber" , C.USER_ID AS "userId" , C.CARD_TYPE AS "cardType" , C.REMARK AS "remark" , C.EXPIRED_DATE AS "expiredDate" , C.ISSUED_DATE AS "issuedDate" , C.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" , C.UPDATED_AT AS "updatedAt" FROM CARD C WHERE C.CARD_ID = #{cardId}
